description: Deliver a working, demonstrable login for the demo: a seeded demo user (an owner/manager account for The Forest Season Resort) with KNOWN, DOCUMENTED credentials, a backend login endpoint that issues a session token, and a frontend login screen + session handling so the user can log in and reach the dashboard scoped to the property. Honors the spec's Auth_Service intent (Req 30): hashed passwords, roles, session token, property scoping, basic account lockout - but demo-grade is acceptable. Auth is currently a STUB (security.py has only pseudonymize/constant_time_equals; no User model, no login endpoint, no login page). Depends on FEAT-001 (the resort exists as a scoping target).
steps: Backend User model + store: add a User model (app/models/user.py or extend models) with id, username/email, display_name, role (one of owner, manager, front_desk, department_staff, destination_official, admin per Req 30), property_id scope, password_hash, and lockout fields (failed_attempts, locked_until). Keep it demo-grade in-memory/singleton consistent with the other services (an @lru_cache-backed auth service), not necessarily SQLite-persisted.

Password hashing in app/core/security.py: add hash_password/verify_password. Prefer argon2 or bcrypt if already available in the backend venv (check `uv run python -c 'import argon2'` / 'import bcrypt'); if neither is installed, add the dependency via `uv add` (OPEN_INTERNET allows it) OR fall back to a clearly-labelled stdlib PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with per-user salt. Do NOT store plaintext passwords. Document which was used in a code comment.

Session tokens: add issue_session_token/verify_session_token in security.py using itsdangerous or an HMAC-signed token keyed off settings.session_secret, carrying user id + role + property_id and a ~12h expiry (Req 30). Add a verify path and a dependency (FastAPI Depends) that resolves the current user from an Authorization: Bearer token or a session cookie.

Auth service + lockout: add app/services/auth/service.py with get_auth_service() (@lru_cache) that seeds the demo users and implements authenticate(username,password) with basic account lockout after N failed attempts (demo-grade), returning a user + token on success.

Login endpoint + router: add app/api/routers/auth.py with POST /auth/login (body: username/email + password) returning { token, user: {id, display_name, role, property_id, property_name} } on success and HTTP 401 on bad credentials / HTTP 423 or 429 when locked out. Add GET /auth/me returning the current user from the token. Register the router in app/api/routers/__init__.py ALL_ROUTERS. Keep /health and the WhatsApp webhook public (Req 30.1); do NOT globally lock down existing endpoints (demo must keep working) - scoping is applied where sensible, but prioritise a working login first and note any thin spots in findings.

Seed the demo account(s): in the auth service seed (or warm.py) create at least one owner/manager user for The Forest Season Resort scoped to property_id 'mus-forestseason' with KNOWN demo credentials. Use a documented demo username (e.g. owner@forestseason.demo) and a documented demo password (e.g. ForestSeason@2024 - pick something and DOCUMENT it). Store only the hash. Ensure seeding runs via seed_all()/warm.py so `python -m app.seed` and the lifespan create the demo user. Keep it idempotent.

Frontend login page (make it PRETTY - explicit user request): add a login route (e.g. frontend/app/login/page.tsx OUTSIDE the (dashboard) group, or a (auth) group) with a visually attractive, polished login screen - NOT a bare form. It must have a nice full-bleed background: use a lush Mussoorie/Uttarakhand forest/mountain mood built from the existing vibrant multi-hue alpine theme (frontend/lib/theme.ts + globals.css) via CSS gradients/layered backgrounds (and optionally a subtle SVG mountain/forest silhouette or a free CSS pattern). NOTE: the user mentioned attaching a background image but NO image file was actually provided to this task - do NOT invent/download a copyrighted image; build the attractive background from theme gradients + lightweight SVG so it stays free and self-contained. If a real image asset is later dropped into frontend/public/, structure the CSS so it can be swapped in by setting a single background-image. Center a themed glass/elevated card (reuse components/ui Card/Button + theme) with The Forest Season Resort / PahadPulse branding, a tagline, the username+password fields, a primary 'Sign in' button, inline error display, and a small 'demo credentials' hint. On submit, POST to /auth/login via a new api.login() in frontend/lib/api.ts; on success store the session token (localStorage and/or cookie) and the user, then redirect to the dashboard home '/'. Ensure it looks good responsively (mobile + desktop).

Frontend session handling: add a lightweight auth client in frontend/lib/ (e.g. auth.ts) to get/set/clear the token + user, and have api.ts attach the Authorization: Bearer token header to requests when present (extend the request() helper). Add a session gate in the (dashboard) layout (frontend/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx) that redirects to /login when no valid session, and show the logged-in user + a Logout action in components/layout/Header.tsx. Keep this demo-grade and resilient (do not hard-crash if the token is missing on first paint).

Scope the dashboard to the property: surface the logged-in user's property (The Forest Season Resort) in the header/shell so the dashboard visibly reads as scoped to that property. Full per-request RBAC enforcement across every endpoint is optional for the demo - note in findings whatever is enforced vs. cosmetic.

Tests - backend: add tests under backend/tests/ for hash/verify roundtrip, POST /auth/login success returns a token + resort-scoped user, wrong password -> 401, lockout after repeated failures, GET /auth/me with a valid token returns the user and with a bad/absent token is rejected, and that the demo credentials seeded match what the README will document.

Tests - frontend: add a Vitest test for the login page/component (renders the branded form with username+password fields and Sign in button, calls api.login on submit, stores token + redirects on success, shows an error on failure) and for the api.login helper / token-attaching request behavior. Keep existing 14 vitest tests green.

VERIFY in-process: `cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed` then a TestClient(app) heredoc: POST /auth/login with the documented demo credentials -> 200 + token; GET /auth/me with that token -> 200 + role/property_id 'mus-forestseason'; POST /auth/login with a wrong password -> 401. Then run all gates: backend ruff + pytest, frontend lint + vitest + build.
acceptance_criteria: POST /auth/login with the documented demo credentials returns HTTP 200 with a session token and a user object scoped to property_id 'mus-forestseason' (The Forest Season Resort); wrong password returns 401; repeated failures trigger lockout.
GET /auth/me returns the current user for a valid token and rejects a missing/invalid token.
Passwords are stored only as hashes (argon2/bcrypt or labelled PBKDF2), never plaintext; session token is signed with session_secret and expires (~12h).
A demo owner/manager account for The Forest Season Resort is seeded idempotently via seed_all()/`python -m app.seed` with credentials that will be documented in the README.

The frontend has a PRETTY /login page with a nice full-bleed themed forest/mountain background (CSS gradients + optional SVG, free/self-contained, swappable for a dropped-in image) and a centered branded card, that authenticates against /auth/login, stores the session, redirects to the dashboard, attaches the Bearer token to API calls, gates the dashboard behind a session, and offers Logout; the header shows the logged-in user + The Forest Season Resort scope.
All quality gates green: backend ruff + pytest (new auth tests included); frontend lint + vitest (new login tests included) + build (route count updated for the new /login route).
verification: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest
cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed

cd backend && uv run python - <<'PY'
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
c=TestClient(app)
r=c.post('/auth/login', json={'username':'owner@forestseason.demo','password':'ForestSeason@2024'})
print('login', r.status_code, str(r.json())[:200])
tok=r.json().get('token') if r.status_code==200 else None
if tok:
    me=c.get('/auth/me', headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {tok}'}); print('me', me.status_code, me.json())
bad=c.post('/auth/login', json={'username':'owner@forestseason.demo','password':'wrong'}); print('bad', bad.status_code)
PY
cd frontend && npm run lint && npx vitest run && npm run build
findings:
Delivered a working, demonstrable login for The Forest Season Resort.

DEMO CREDENTIALS (seeded idempotently via seed_all()/`python -m app.seed`, documented in README):
- Owner:   username `owner@forestseason.demo`  / password `ForestSeason@2024`  (role=owner, property_id=mus-forestseason)
- Manager: username `manager@forestseason.demo`/ password `Mussoorie@2024`     (role=manager, property_id=mus-forestseason)
Both scoped to property_id 'mus-forestseason' -> property_name 'The Forest Season Resort' (resolved via market_radar.analytics_dataset.property_name).

LIBS USED:
- Password hashing: argon2 via passlib's CryptContext(schemes=['argon2']). passlib[argon2] was ALREADY a declared backend dependency (pyproject.toml), so no `uv add` was needed. Hashes are self-describing `$argon2id$...` strings; plaintext is never stored. (bcrypt/itsdangerous are NOT installed; a labelled PBKDF2 fallback was the documented alternative but not needed.)
- Session token: stdlib HMAC-SHA256 (hashlib+hmac) signed `<base64url(payload)>.<base64url(sig)>` keyed off settings.session_secret, carrying sub/role/property_id/iat/exp with a ~12h expiry (SESSION_TTL_SECONDS=12h). verify_session_token checks signature in constant time + expiry; malformed/expired/tampered tokens return None. No third-party token lib (keeps it free/self-contained).

BACKEND: new app/models/user.py (User + PublicUser + Role enum per Req 30, lockout fields failed_attempts/locked_until). app/services/auth/service.py = @lru_cache get_auth_service() AuthService seeding the two demo users, authenticate() with lockout after 5 failed attempts for 15 min, user_from_token(). app/api/routers/auth.py = POST /auth/login (200 {token, user{id,username,display_name,role,property_id,property_name}}; 401 bad creds / unknown user; 423 Locked when locked out) and GET /auth/me (resolves current user from Authorization: Bearer header OR `session` cookie; 401 missing/invalid). Router registered first in ALL_ROUTERS. Auth service warmed in warm.py so `python -m app.seed` + lifespan seed it idempotently.

RBAC/SCOPING ENFORCED vs COSMETIC: get_current_user dependency is REAL (validates signature+expiry, resolves user) and is applied on GET /auth/me. Property scoping is carried in the token + returned user object and surfaced in the UI. The existing demo endpoints (market-radar, sentinel, destination, concierge, etc.) are INTENTIONALLY left ungated per the briefing/Req 30.1 so the demo keeps working - i.e. per-request RBAC on those endpoints is NOT enforced (thin spot, documented). /health and the WhatsApp webhook remain public. The dashboard property-scope display and the login gate are enforced client-side (demo-grade): the token is stored in localStorage, attached as a Bearer header to all api.ts calls, and the (dashboard) layout SessionGate redirects to /login when no token is present. This is cosmetic gating, not server-enforced authorization on data endpoints.

FRONTEND: pretty full-bleed /login page OUTSIDE the (dashboard) group (frontend/app/login/page.tsx) - layered alpine CSS gradient background (sky->forest->dawn) + decorative blur blobs + inline SVG layered mountain ridge & pine silhouettes (free/self-contained; swappable for a real image dropped into frontend/public/ via a single backgroundImage, documented in a code comment since the user mentioned an image but none reached the task). Centered glassy elevated branded card (PahadPulse / The Forest Season Resort / region badge / tagline / ridge divider), username+password fields, primary Sign in button, inline role=alert error, one-click demo-credentials hint. Responsive (max-w-md, sm: breakpoints). components/auth/LoginForm.tsx (client) posts via new api.login(); on success setSession() stores token+user and router.push('/'). lib/auth.ts = SSR-safe localStorage session store (getToken/getUser/setSession/clearSession/isAuthenticated). lib/api.ts request() now attaches Authorization: Bearer when a token exists + api.login()/api.me(). components/auth/SessionGate.tsx gates the (dashboard) layout (redirects to /login, renders nothing until ready, no first-paint crash). Header.tsx shows the logged-in display_name + property_name + role, a property Badge, and a Log out button. lib/demoCredentials.ts shares the documented creds with the hint.

TESTS: backend tests/test_auth.py (9 tests): hash/verify roundtrip + non-plaintext, session token roundtrip/tamper/expiry, login success returns resort-scoped user, wrong-password 401, unknown-user 401, lockout after repeated failures (isolated AuthService instance), /auth/me valid token, /auth/me rejects missing+invalid token, seeded demo creds match hash. frontend LoginForm.test.tsx (3) + lib/api.test.ts (3): renders branded form, calls api.login+stores session+redirects on success, inline error on failure, api.login POST shape, Bearer header attached only when a token exists.

GATES (all green): backend `uv run ruff check .` clean + `uv run pytest` 255 passed (was 246, +9). frontend `npm run lint` clean + `npx vitest run` 20 passed (was 14, +6) + `npm run build` 22 routes (was 21, +1 /login). In-process TestClient verification: login 200 w/ token, /auth/me 200 role=owner property_id=mus-forestseason, wrong password 401.

STEERING: (1) pretty login page WITH nice bg -> delivered (gradient+SVG, no copyrighted image since none was actually attached; structured so a real image can be dropped in later). (2) live URL -> NOT possible: the sandbox dev-server guard blocks live uvicorn/next listeners and the context forbids provisioning AWS/paid cloud (keep everything free); so no live URL can be produced from here. The app runs locally via `make demo` (http://localhost:3000) and is deployable free (Codespaces/Vercel+local API) - this is a documentation-only note for the orchestrator to relay. (3) continue -> proceeded to completion.
